authority.document: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.contract: The legacy object owner is a soft pointer and may use relative soft-pointer encodings; common persistent reactors are absolute soft pointers; the extension dictionary is a hard owner, including a typed null. DICTIONARY item handles are soft owners.

change.behavior: The shared common-tail observer now keeps relative soft-pointer decoding on the owner only. Reactor references must retain absolute role 4; the extension dictionary retains role 3. Tests call the shared legacy dictionary observer directly.
change.ownerCompatibility: The generated AC1012 pair and existing control retain valid role-12 relative owner decoding.

limits: Generated files remain in scratch storage and are not repository fixtures.
The paired files demonstrate source graph and value discrimination, not native normal-open, duplicate-merge, clone, or WBLOCK behavior.
Strict AC1012 output remains guarded and no DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
